description: Voranschlag Gleisdorf 2023 (Gemeinde) is a dataset listed in opendataportal.at, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by offenerhaushalt.at. Estimates of the municipality – revenue and expenditure. Coverage: AT. The portal shows the English title as "Estimate Gleisdorf 2023 (municipality)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Vermoegenshaushalt, Rechnungsabschluss, Haushalt, Budget, Ergebnishaushalt, Einnahmen. The listing shows 2 download or service links in CSV. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.de). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-open-data-portal-austria.
